_about: How scripts/set-domain.js classifies every occurrence of the old host. Order matters: file rules first, then line rules, first match wins. rewrite = change it. historical = never change it (a record of a crawl or scan of the old host). protected = change only with --include-protected, and only inside URL literals. Anything that matches nothing is unclassified: it is reported, not changed, and the run exits 2.
